literature_notes: All four ledger lines come from a single paper (PMC11295008) studying mouse TRAAK (KCNK4). L1/L2/L3 describe a SEP-TAC–TRAAK chimera in which full-length TRAAK is fused downstream of the SEP-TAC transmembrane reporter. The superecliptic pHluorin (SEP) tag resides on SEP-TAC's own extracellular domain; it is not inserted into any loop or terminus of TRAAK itself. The construct demonstrates surface expression of TRAAK but does not constitute an epitope-tag insertion into TRAAK's extracellular face, so it yields no qualifying site. L4 reports an HA tag at the N-terminus of mouse TRAAK; the canonical topology places residues 1–5 (MRSTT) in the intracellular compartment, with TM1 beginning at residue 6. The HA tag is therefore cytoplasmic, not extracellular, and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports an insertion on the extracellular face of KCNK4.

literature_other_positions.note: HA tag placed at the N-terminus of full-length mouse TRAAK; topology landmarks place residues 1–5 in the intracellular compartment (TM1 begins at residue 6), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
